 Jarrett Allen (knee) listed questionable Saturday 
 by Ari Koslow | Cavaliers Correspondent | Sat, Nov 14th 2026, 2:58pm EST 
 Jarrett Allen is listed as questionable for Saturday’s game against the Mavericks. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Allen is one of several players listed as questionable for Cleveland. Evan Mobley (toe) was ruled out, so Allen would be in line for a bigger role if he is cleared.
